title: Matam bapa hai zainab e dukhya guzar gayi
body:
MAATAM BAPA HAI ZAINAB-E-DUKHIYA GUZAR GAYEEN, ZEHRA KI BETI SANIYE ZEHRA GUZAR GAYEEN
ZAKHIME THI PUSHT BHALON SE SEENA FIGAAR THA, SEH SEH KE ZULM-O-JOR ADOO KA GUZAR GAYI
PEHLOO MEIN DARD PEHLU-E-ZEHRA LIYE HUE, TASVEERE SABR-E-FATIMA ZEHRA GUZAR GAYI
RUDAD-E-KARBALA JOSUNATI THI SUBH-O-SHAAM, WO GHAM RASIDA BHAYI KI SHAIDA GUZAR GAYI
<<DIVIDER>>
BAADE HUSSAIN KAAM SAMBHALA HUSSAIN KA, BEKAS GHAREEB AAJ KHUDAYA GUZAR GAYI
BESAR JO DEKHA BHAYI KA LAASHA ZAMEEN PAR, DIL KO BANAAYE QHABR KI DUNIYA GUZAR GAYI
ZAINAB KI MOUT KAM NAHIN QATLE HUSSAIN SE, AYE KARBALA HUSSAIN KI SHAIDA GUZAR GAYI
TARMEEM GHAM SE CHAAK GAREBAAN HOGAYE, GHAM KI SATAYI ZAINAB-E-DUKHIYA GUZAR GAYI..
